OBJECTSYNTH
The object shown in every tab. TRY YOUR OWN! adds yours.

Wavetable conversion

How a photo becomes the oscillator's waveform. Two readings of the same object: the shape, read column by column, and the texture, read ring by ring in its 2D spectrum. Scroll inside each panel to run its steps; the wavetable then morphs from one to the other.

photo + SAM mask→shape: columns → 64 harmonics+texture: rings → 64 harmonics→32 frames

Macro implementation

Every preset starts as a photo and the object's SAM mask. Six measurements are taken, each is mapped to 0–1 with a fixed range, and each macro then turns its own synth parameters. Turn a macro knob (drag, scroll or arrow keys) and watch what follows, or pick another object from the menu at the top.

photo + SAM mask→measurement→fixed range → 0–1→macro→synth parameters

Effects

The object's wavetable through the synth's own chain, set by its macros. Hold a note, open an effect from the toolbar and turn it: the instrument that shows it best lights up.

wavetable frame→unison→voice filter + env→amp env→filter bank ← LFO→distortion→chorus
Object: Teapota dataset photo. Pick another from the menu at the top, or press TRY YOUR OWN!

The wavetable · 32 frames

Each frame mixes the two spectra harmonic by harmonic, always with the shape's phases, so the middle frames never cancel out. The synth's frame knob scans these.

Oscilloscope

Shape in time. Distortion squares it, filters round it, chorus makes it breathe.

Spectrum

Harmonics, low to high. Dashed: the low-pass curves.

Stereo field

Left vs right. Mono is a line; spread and chorus open it.

Envelope

Loudness over the last 4 s: ADSR and the LFO's pulse.

Click an effect's name in the toolbar to open its controls; the dot switches it on and off.

Try your own

The macro server is not running. It runs our own SAM and macro code (CV/macro_server.py) on this computer. From the repository folder, start it with:

.venv/bin/python CV/macro_server.py

Then open http://127.0.0.1:8765 (the camera works there in every browser), or press Retry.
